subject: Qualification
notes: kb/Work/PB466.md - both sentences. Sentence 1, 'If explicitly referenced, a paragraph-name shall not be duplicated within a section', is COBOL2122, reported from the reference and not from the declaration because the rule is conditioned on the explicit reference - an unreferenced duplicate is conforming and compiles, which the positive witness measures with UNREF-DUP declared twice in one section and once more in another. The message says RENAME rather than QUALIFY because 8.4.2.2.2 format 4 offers a paragraph-name only its section-name and both declarations carry the same one. Sentence 2, 'A paragraph-name need not be qualified when referred to from within the same section', is the rule-6 arm (SR-8.4.2.2.1-6) and is witnessed by the same positive golden. The multiplicity the rule asks about is kept by ProcedureNameMap, which replaced five Dictionary.TryAdd registrations that discarded it; ProcedureNameUniquenessDriftTests pins that no scope may reintroduce one and fails its scanner on the pre-fix lines.
